Changelog

globalvuln 0.2.0

  • Added a registry-driven targets data pipeline with strict validation, change analysis, provenance, and atomic publication.
  • Added automated adapters for 15 public sources and a validated manual ingestion adapter for the IDMC disaster-displacement model.
  • Added globalvuln_data() for explicit bundled or approved live data access.
  • Added source_status() for cadence-aware source freshness information.
  • Added a versioned static pins board and scheduled update pull requests.

globalvuln 0.1.0

  • Added collate_indices() to combine a user-selected set of indices in wide or long format, with rank-based top-10 and top-20 counts and proportions.
  • Added a consistently structured dataset for every individual index.
  • Added publisher, edition, retrieval, checksum, licensing, and coverage metadata.
